world_fit_review.observations: Large rounded head, brown/white oval eyes, short standing torso, simple paws and human-like arm position match the Siamese cat/hedgehog/tiger pattern. It is clearly a standing cast mouse rather than the exceptional bean-shaped hamster design.
world_fit_review.basis: Current user two-pattern instruction; assistant visual judgment after viewing current source and both background composites, not a user click.
